pairs.summary: DMRTA2 and HMBOX1 motifs co-occur in the same accessible ~300 bp windows more often than expected after matching GC, accessibility and repeat content, in 4 of 14 profiles analysed (HepG2 hepatoblastoma/liver cancer; K562 chronic myelogenous leukemia; Zhang2021 hepatic tissue | Endothelial (Exocrine Tissues); Zhang2021 hepatic tissue | Hepatocyte). Median lift 1.62x, typical spacing ~50 bp between sites. In 4 profile(s) the enrichment is seen in both replicate halves and the motifs are distinguishable. This is a sequence-level hypothesis to test (e.g. ChIP/CUT&RUN co-binding, motif mutagenesis), not a confirmed interaction.
